query: Quick description-only pass please, I know there is no dossier for SHOP-211 (tickets/SHOP-211.md) and I do not want you to fetch anything else. Just the gap analysis from the ticket as it stands.
expected_behavior: Takes the explicit description-only exception and produces the analysis
Labels the result description-only, so nobody reads it as a full gap analysis
Classifies the one drafted AC against the existing specs and tests
Says what a dossier would likely add rather than pretending the input was complete
Writes nothing to tests/, specs/ or COVERAGE.md
